name: diary-period-variants
description: Приёмочный прогон отборов «Дневника» (ошибки 0114e9c3 и 73fa3c3b): подсветка предопределённых наборов и применение периода с разными токенами/литералами и дополнительным условием. Сид записей — из страницы (window.etn.comments.create) на фиксированных днях. Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.diary-period-73fa3c3b.scenario.json --out .tmp/etn-73fa3c3b/out

steps.name: seed-records
steps.eval: (async () => { const nid = '{{networkId}}'; const seed = '{{thoughtId}}'; const mk = async (title, day) => { const d = new Date(day + 'T12:00:00'); const t = d.toISOString(); return window.etn.comments.create(nid, 'thought', seed, { kind: 'chronological', title, body_md: 'запись ' + day, valid_from: t, valid_to: t }); }; await mk('День П 2026-10-05', '2026-10-05'); await mk('День 1 2026-10-12', '2026-10-12'); await mk('День 3 2026-10-14', '2026-10-14'); await mk('День Чт 2026-10-15', '2026-10-15'); await mk('День 5 2026-10-16', '2026-10-16'); await mk('День 7 2026-10-18', '2026-10-18'); await mk('Сентябрь 2026-09-01', '2026-09-01'); return true; })()

steps.name: today-state
steps.probe: ({ days: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length, selected: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length, from: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null })

steps.name: open-saved-week
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .ff-extra--saved'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: week-state
steps.probe: ({ days: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length, records: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-record').length, selected: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length, selectedDays: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected')).map((e) => e.getAttribute('title')), from: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null, to: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="to"] select')?.value ?? null })

steps.name: open-saved-30
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .ff-extra--saved'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: set-month-tokens
steps.eval: (() => { const reset = (b) => { const r = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="' + b + '"] .fv-date__reset'); if (r) { r.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); r.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); } }; const setSel = (b, v) => { const s = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="' + b + '"] select.fv-date__anchor'); if (!s) throw new Error('нет селекта ' + b); s.value = v; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; reset('from'); reset('to'); setSel('from', '$monthStart'); setSel('to', '$monthEnd'); return true; })()

steps.name: press-apply-month
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .ff-apply'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: month-state
steps.probe: ({ days: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length, selected: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length, from: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null, to: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="to"] select')?.value ?? null })

steps.name: set-literal-dates
steps.eval: (() => { const setSel = (b, v) => { const s = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="' + b + '"] select'); s.value = v; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; setSel('from', 'exact'); setSel('to', 'exact'); const setInp = (b, v) => { const i = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="' + b + '"] input'); i.value = v; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; setInp('from', '2026-10-12'); setInp('to', '2026-10-14'); return true; })()

steps.name: press-apply-literal
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .ff-apply'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: set-single-today
steps.eval: (() => { const setSel = (b, v) => { const s = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="' + b + '"] select.fv-date__anchor'); s.value = v; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; setSel('from', '$today'); setSel('to', '$today'); return true; })()

steps.name: press-apply-single
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .ff-apply'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: open-saved-title
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .ff-extra--saved'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()
